#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Rebuild the A7 L1 roadmap projection directly from its checked-in registry.
This does not fetch, claim or rewrite external provider approval.
"""
import argparse,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
P=R/"registry/roadmap.json"
# A7-specific website worklist; original source remains complete and audit-visible.
WORKLIST={"A7-N04","A7-N05","A7-N06","A7-N10","A7-N13"}
def build(commit):
    raw=P.read_bytes()
    reg=json.loads(raw)
    delivered=[{k:x.get(k) for k in ("id","stage","title","status","detail")} for x in reg["developed"]]
    backlog=[{k:x.get(k) for k in ("id","priority","title","state","done_when")} for x in reg["next"] if x["id"] in WORKLIST]
    pins=reg.get("pinned_task_ids",[])
    if len(pins)!=len(set(pins)) or not set(pins).issubset({x["id"] for x in backlog}): raise ValueError("Duplicate or unknown pinned task")
    pinned=[dict(next(x for x in backlog if x["id"]==tid),pin_reason=reg["pin_semantics"][tid]["reason"],task_boundary=reg["pin_semantics"][tid]["boundary"]) for tid in pins]
    if not delivered or not backlog or len(backlog)!=len(WORKLIST): raise ValueError("Roadmap source missing a workstream")
    # Show only dated, GitHub-verified local A7 evidence already recorded in the
    # owning bootstrap. This is a fixed historical observation, NOT live polling.
    boot=json.loads((R/"A7_BOOTSTRAP.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    local=boot.get("a7_operator_quickstart",{})
    ev=local.get("final_closeout_evidence",{})
    proof=None
    if local.get("final_closeout_ci")=="VERIFIED_FINAL_MAIN_WORKFLOWS" and ev.get("state")=="VERIFIED":
        proof={"sequence":local["sequence_id"],"source_path":"A7_BOOTSTRAP.json",
          "verified_commit_sha":ev["verified_against_main_commit"],
          "registry_run":ev["registry_run"],"pages_run":ev["pages_run"],
          "release_safeguard_run":ev["release_safeguard_run"],
          "conclusions":ev["conclusions"],
          "independent_http_body_readback":ev["independent_http_body_readback"],
          "historical_not_live":True}
    return {"verified_a7_provider_evidence":proof,"schema":"a7-roadmap-projection.v0.1","kind":"DERIVED_NOT_AUTHORITATIVE",
      "owner":"A7_ONLY","source_path":"registry/roadmap.json","source_sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
      "site_build_commit":commit,"current_closed_sequence":reg["current_closed_sequence"],
      "developed":delivered,"next_a7":backlog,"pinned_a7":pinned,
      "caveat":"Registry-recorded statuses only. Check GitHub PRs, commits and Actions for current provider facts."}
if __name__=="__main__":
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument("--output",required=True);p.add_argument("--commit-sha",required=True);a=p.parse_args()
    dst=Path(a.output);dst.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True,parents=True)
    d=build(a.commit_sha);dst.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    print("A7 ROADMAP PROJECTION PASS closed="+d["current_closed_sequence"]+" delivered="+str(len(d["developed"]))+" a7_backlog="+str(len(d["next_a7"])))

#!/usr/bin/env python3 """Verify L1 A7 roadmap source provenance and navigation contract.""" import json,sys,re from pathlib import Path R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] sys.path.insert(0,str(R/"scripts")) from generate_a7_roadmap import build D=build("CI_LOCAL_SOURCE") S=json.loads((R/"registry/roadmap.json").read_text()) assert D["current_closed_sequence"]==S["current_closed_sequence"] # The evidence projection must be derived from bootstrap, not a duplicate editable log. boot=json.loads((R/"A7_BOOTSTRAP.json").read_text()) e=boot["a7_operator_quickstart"]["final_closeout_evidence"] proof=D["verified_a7_provider_evidence"] assert proof["sequence"]==boot["a7_operator_quickstart"]["sequence_id"] assert proof["verified_commit_sha"]==e["verified_against_main_commit"] assert (proof["registry_run"],proof["pages_run"],proof["release_safeguard_run"])==(e["registry_run"],e["pages_run"],e["release_safeguard_run"]) assert proof["historical_not_live"] is True and proof["independent_http_body_readback"] is False assert D["kind"]=="DERIVED_NOT_AUTHORITATIVE" and D["owner"]=="A7_ONLY" assert D["developed"]==[{k:x.get(k) for k in ("id","stage","title","status","detail")} for x in S["developed"]] assert {x["id"] for x in D["next_a7"]}=={"A7-N04","A7-N05","A7-N06","A7-N10","A7-N13"} assert [x["id"] for x in D["pinned_a7"]]==S["pinned_task_ids"]==["A7-N05","A7-N10","A7-N04"] assert D["pinned_a7"][-1]["task_boundary"]=="PEER_READ_ONLY_HOLD" assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}",D["source_sha256"]) h=(R/"site/roadmap.html").read_text();js=(R/"site/assets/a7-roadmap.js").read_text() assert 'id="roadmapSequence"' in h and 'id="roadmapDeveloped"' in h assert 'id="roadmap-evidence"' in h and 'id="roadmapEvidence"' in h assert "verified_a7_provider_evidence" in js and "historical_not_live" in js assert 'id="roadmapUpcoming"' in h and 'id="roadmapPinned"' in h and 'data/a7-roadmap.json' in js assert 'd.next_a7.filter(x=>!pinnedIds.has(x.id))' in js assert "textContent" in js and "innerHTML" not in js assert "21Last fully closed" not in h assert "R&D" not in h and "A9" not in h # The numbered POST is an exact archive of every live UI/code path, # not a parallel editable registry. PRE retains original Git object identities. archive=R/"registry/archives/roadmap-evidence-ui" a=json.loads((archive/"000001_PRE_A7_SEQ_000042.json").read_text()) assert a["subject_id"]=="A7-ROADMAP-EVIDENCE-UI" and a["phase"]=="PRE" assert len(a["live_sources"])==5 post=archive/"000001_POST_A7_SEQ_000042.json" if post.exists(): z=json.loads(post.read_text()) assert z["phase"]=="POST" and z["subject_id"]==a["subject_id"] assert {x["path"] for x in z["live_sources"]}=={x["path"] for x in a["live_sources"]} assert all((R/x["path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")==x["content"] for x in z["live_sources"]) print("A7 L1 ROADMAP SOURCE QA PASS closed="+D["current_closed_sequence"])
